pr_title: drivers: flash: stm32 flash base address from the DTS node
pr_body:
For the flash driver, the base address is the MCU internal flash address (usually 0x8000000). This PR gets  that address from the device tree node "st,stm32-nv-flash"
instead of relying on the CONFIG_FLASH_BASE_ADDRESS which might differ when building for another flash memory.

Fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/67986
pr_comments: adding the nucleo_f767zi target to the list of boards running the tests/drivers/flash/common/

issue_context.title: stm32 flash driver should not use CONFIG_FLASH_BASE_ADDRESS
issue_context.body:
In all the stm32 flash drivers (drivers/flash/flash_stm32XX.c), the address of the FLASH to read/write to,  is considered as CONFIG_FLASH_BASE_ADDRESS but should not.

It should  be retrieved from the **soc_nv_flash** node using DT_REG_ADDR()  instead.

The flash_stm32XX.c driver is the driver for the internal MCU flash where its base address is 0x8000000. Until now this corresponds to the memory where the sw application is build/linked/executed.
The situation differs when compiling/linking/executing  an application for a different CONFIG_FLASH_BASE_ADDRESS than the internal flash memory (typically an external NOR memory).
